title: One process, four threads
desc: A drawing of one app process holding four threads, the heap they all share, the private stack each one keeps, and the single thread that reaches the screen.

steps.note: One process, one address space, one page table. Everything below is inside it.
One path of execution runs through it. Android calls your code on this one.
Three more you never created: drawing, calls from other processes, garbage collection.
All four see the same objects, at the same addresses, with no copying.
Each keeps its own stack: its local variables and the chain of calls that got it here.
Only the main thread may touch the screen, and it produces every frame.
